Mod.name: Field Imbue
Mod.description:
Adds [b]Field resonance[/b], a new modifier for circle spells (Circle of fervour, stillness, thunder, ...).
Cast it together with a circle and any other modifiers. The circle then: [list] [*]gives those modifiers to every projectile that flies through it: a Spark bolt through a Burning trail circle comes out burning, through a Homing circle it homes, through a Heavy shot circle it hits harder [*]keeps applying their effects (fire, freeze, oil, poison, ...) to enemies standing inside it, on-hit ones too: curses keep enemies cursed, Petrify turns wounded enemies to stone, Charm on toxic sludge charms radioactive ones [*]runs their material converters (Water to poison, ...) over the whole circle [*]shows what it carries: its rim sparkles in a colour per modifier (ice blue for Freeze charge, orange for fire, purple for curses, ...) [/list] Field resonance also works inside a trigger payload: Spark bolt with trigger -> Field resonance -> Freeze charge -> Circle of fervour throws an imbuing freezing circle. [b]Resonant field[/b] is a new circle spell with Field resonance built in and no effect of its own: put modifiers in front of it and they go straight into the field (Freeze charge -> Resonant field).
Works with 130 vanilla modifiers, and modifiers from other mods are picked up automatically. Circles cast without Field resonance stay vanilla.
[b]Settings[/b] (apply from the next new run): [list] [*]Imbue enemy projectiles (off): circles also imbue enemy shots [*]Allow Nuke orbit and Chaos magic (off): lets circles hand those out too - can cause heavy lag [/list] [b]Entangled Worlds[/b]: works in multiplayer. Every player needs the mod and the same settings.
[b]Sign Flip[/b]: with the Sign Flip mod, circles hand out flipped modifiers too: [list] [*]Sign flip -> Damage plus: the circle heals what the bolts hit [*]Sign flip -> Homing: the bolts flee enemies [*]Sign flip -> Explosive projectile or Clustermod (Sign Flip 0.2.0 or newer): the bolts implode - they pull things in, then explode with 3x the damage in a third of the radius. The circle implodes too when it ends. [/list] https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3826087249
Source, notes and issues: https://github.com/MrWong99/noita-field-imbue (MIT)
